headline: Orchard Textiles opens new production line in Curitiba
body: Orchard Textiles commissioned a new line at its Curitiba site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Orchard Textiles signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Orchard Textiles announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Orchard Textiles executives arrested in bribery probe
body: Authorities detained senior executives of Orchard Textiles as part of a bribery investigation. The board has suspended the individuals pending the outcome.

headline: Orchard Textiles faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Orchard Textiles. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Orchard Textiles cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Orchard Textiles lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Orchard Textiles announces layoffs affecting 10% of workforce
body: Orchard Textiles said it will cut 10% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Orchard Textiles reports record quarterly revenue
body: Orchard Textiles reported revenue growth of 14% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.
